simple.meaning: הָרַס (hâraç) appears 43 times in the Hebrew Scriptures and is introduced in connection with priesthood and in connection with prophetic witness. The surrounding account also brings the name into death.
simple.biblicalBackground: The first appearances are in Exodus, Judges, 2 Samuel, 1 Kings, 2 Kings, and 11 more, beginning at Exodus 15:7. BibleIQ detects the main surrounding context as family, altar, death, covenant, priesthood, prophetic witness.
